notes.title: New looks, Events & Other Surprises
notes.content: [h2]August has been an exciting and productive month for the Bytebond team, and we’re thrilled to share what we’ve been up to![/h2][p][/p][h3][b]🪞 New Looks[/b]​[/h3][p]We’ve started implementing a whole new range of different looks for our brave little robots! Whether you’re a fan of cats, bugs, nature, or even crocheting, everyone will find a design to customize their character. We can’t wait to see which one will become the most popular! Here are a few examples of our works:[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/376a625e6b02a63f29bd6cc6c9b167971ac8fda1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/1dee601c224bf320afd0daa669230dd77e92769a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/e6ed550a393ec8600f8c62cc5abd2443fe535eb4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/a9209227475b0d374c247dd9a7fc11f9af8347c2.png"][/img][/carousel][h3][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f3ae.png"][/img] [b]​​Gamescom in Cologne​​[/b][/h3][p]We had the amazing opportunity to showcase Bytebond at Gamescom in Cologne. It was an unforgettable experience—so many people stopped by to watch, play, and chat about our game. We’re incredibly grateful for all the support and enthusiasm you showed us there! 💪[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/bdc3301520540435daad68e2dc7c196ae1b8e1ac.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f579-fe0f.png"][/img] [b]​​Community Playtests[/b]​​[/h3][p]We’ve been running community playtests, and the feedback from our Discord community has been invaluable. We’re genuinely amazed by the things you’ve noticed and pointed out. Thanks to your keen eyes and thoughtful comments, Bytebond will be even better! 💙[/p][h3][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f30e.png"][/img] [b]​​PAX West & The MIX[/b]​​[/h3][p]We’re also currently showing Bytebond at PAX in Seattle and taking part in the MIX! It’s a humongous opportunity for an indie game like ours to reach fans of the genre, and we couldn’t be more grateful to the organizers for the nomination - it means the world to us 😊[/p][p][/p][p]This month was extremely busy, but that’s nothing compared to what’s coming in September… Get ready, and stay tuned! More info soon![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time [/p][p][b]Bleep & Bloop OUT! ⚡[/b]  [/p][p]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3]⚡Add Bytebond to your Steam Wishlist⚡[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952690/Bytebond/"][/dynamiclink]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3]⚡Previous update⚡[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1952690/announcements/detail/539987488382387442"][/dynamiclink]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/AnsharPublishing"]🤖 Follow Anshar Publishing on Steam 🤖[/url][/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/b21c7265c478a6bdbbfdcb69f1a35d7d19364cdc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Become a Community Playtester – Play Early, Share Feedback, Earn Rewards!
notes.content: [h2]We’re excited to announce that we’re opening up ​​[b][i]Community Playtests[/i]​​[/b] and we’re looking for [b]brave playtesters[/b] from our amazing community! [/h2][p]This is a chance to help us shape the game before release and get a sneak peek at everything we’ve been working on. [/p][h3]⚠️ Important! [/h3][p][b]You will need a friend to play with[/b]. While there is a way to play Bytebond solo, the game is [b]made to be played in co-op[/b], and we need to playtest it that way. You can play in couch co-op or online, it's up to you. If you don't have anyone to play with, you can still apply — we'll do our best to find you a pair over Discord![/p][h3]🤖 We’re especially looking for your feedback on two key aspects:[/h3][p]1.  ​[b]Controls:[/b]​ Does the steering scheme on controller/keyboard + mouse make sense to you, or do you find it confusing and would like to see changes?[/p][p]2.  ​[b]Pacing & Difficulty:[/b]​ Do the biomes gradually get harder as you progress (as they should), or do you notice some areas are harder and then suddenly easier (which shouldn’t happen)?[/p][p][b]A full playthrough should take about 5-6 hours.[/b] [/p][h3]🤖 As a thank you for your time and feedback, you’ll get:[/h3][p]▶️ Early access to the game[/p][p]▶️ Your name in the credits[/p][p]▶️ Game key of your choice from Anshar Publishing's catalogue​​![/p][p]The drawback? [b]You’ll see the whole game before release and will mostly encounter some bugs we’re still working on and polishing.[/b][/p][h3]🤖 [b]How to join:[/b][/h3][p]1.  Join the [b][url="https://discord.gg/sMFWjmWvaU"]Anshar Publishing server[/url] on Discord[/b].[/p][p]2.  In ​[b]#roles[/b]​, grab yourself the [b]Playtester role[/b].[/p][p]3.  Post “I’m ready to test!” (or something along those lines 😉) in ​[b]#bytebond-feedback[/b]​ and our community manager will send you a key![/p][p][/p][h3]Testing runs until ​​[b][i]August 31st[/i]​​.[/b] [/h3][p]We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and make the game even better together![/p][p][/p][p][b]Bleep & Bloop OUT! ⚡[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952690/Bytebond"][/dynamiclink]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/p][h3][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/AnsharPublishing?snr=2___"]🎮 Follow us on Steam! 🎮[/url][/b][/h3][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//41215820/b5c9da8d3f49352842d848e05719002e4cd946df.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Enemy Tactics and Digital Storms
notes.content: [h2]Greetings, Defenders! 🛡️  [/h2][p]We’ve been hard at work to bring you another wave of awesome updates—and we’re thrilled to show you what’s new in the latest version of Bytebond! Let’s jump in 😉[/p][h3][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f998.png"][/img] [b]​​Jumping Enemies[/b]​​[/h3][p]We’ve wrapped up work on the last of our bad guy types—the jumper! Not only is this enemy ready to leap into action, but it also received a full VFX overhaul to make encounters even more exciting.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/3caf6f1e7d7e44d110851cc7815402847aaedc45.gif"][/img][/p][h3][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f329-fe0f.png"][/img] [b]​​Mysterious Storms[/b]​​[/h3][p]A strange digital storm is brewing, playing a key role in our robot’s journey. We don’t want to spoil the surprise, so for now, enjoy the cool VFX—what it all means is for you to discover![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/03f6fbad787dd00df4466f45b8022f686c87f3dd.gif"][/img][/p][h3][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f5a5-fe0f.png"][/img] [b]​​New Level Decorations[/b]​​[/h3][p]Our levels are looking even more interesting with the addition of old PC monitors, stacks of paper, and GPU racks. Why are these objects inside a computer? You’ll have to play the game to uncover the mystery![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/a72736ae61f51c9b9a2437bf9fe7fe78d5d862a7.png"][/img][/p][h3][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f41e.png"][/img] ​[b]Bugs (the Cute Kind!)[/b]​[/h3][p]We’re bringing more life to our levels by adding adorable chip-bugs and other little critters. Keep an eye out for these charming inhabitants as you explore![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/54308ea7d1df2ef93041309ac2539176404bf4c9.png"][/img][/p][h3][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4a1.png"][/img] [b]​​Virus Lamps[/b]​​[/h3][p]Virus lighting just got creepier! We’ve added eerie tentacle lights to make the atmosphere even more immersive and mysterious.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/e53a215f18b0bc18401f6c5c6a856a6687ba3f0c.png"][/img][/p][p]Let us know what you think, and stay tuned for more updates![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time [/p][p][b]Bleep & Bloop OUT! ⚡[/b]  [/p][p]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3]⚡Add Bytebond to your Steam Wishlist⚡[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952690/Bytebond/"][/dynamiclink]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3]⚡Previous update⚡[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1952690/announcements/detail/539981147242759788"][/dynamiclink]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/AnsharPublishing"][b]🤖 Follow Anshar Publishing on Steam 🤖[/b][/url][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/3c16ba5aeabe56c1f0eab668430a5ef5468338da.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Reactive Beats, Fresh Looks, and Global Access!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Defenders! 🛡️[/h2]

[h3]We’ve been hard at work to bring you some exciting updates, and we’re thrilled to share what’s new in the latest version of the game. Let’s dive in![/h3]

[h3]​​🎼 Reactive Barriers VFX​​​ [/h3]
The Sound Card chapter just got a major glow-up! [b]The level barriers now react in real time to the in-game music[/b], creating a dynamic and immersive experience. Watch as the visuals pulse and shift to the beat—your journey through the soundscape has never looked (or felt) this good!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/bac1c0018ffbdf1922ab093f9ef6f1d2b8a11d1d.gif[/img]

[h3]​⚠️ Glitch VFX​​​[/h3]
Beware of the evil virus! It’s not just lurking in the shadows anymore—it’s actively trying to mess with the computer. [b]You’ll notice occasional screen glitches in the GPU Biome[/b], adding a touch of chaos and tension to your adventure. Stay sharp!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/595ed003c2ce3f15e5e949b25218f8b7b1d18a13.gif[/img]

[h3]🎨​ Complete UI Overhaul​​​[/h3]
We’ve completely redesigned the user interface from the ground up! [b]With brand-new buttons, panels, and elements, the UI now complements Bytebond’s art style.[/b] It’s sleeker, more intuitive (hopefully!), and a joy to navigate. What do you guys think?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/99f23a58397695093b1b4ac105a35dba19fcaf38.png[/img]

[h3]💬 Localization[/h3]
Bytebond is now more accessible than ever! [b]We’re proud to announce full support for 12 different languages.[/b] No matter where you’re playing from, we’ve got you covered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/2753d2d45dc2a5ca0ad2bf530f5f75621b2ba01d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/8d5ae98a5d179fbfbc6dd1ef14b5e5438197e1d9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/2c938e84970c15dbf4dcdd19d1f40cc355acfc62.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/66788af055fd578f057321d2ba436b7a1bd84766.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates!

Until next time

notes.title: Online Multiplayer, a Colorful Wave and even more Puzzles!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Defenders! 🛡️[/h2]

[h3]We're excited to share some recent updates with you. Let's dive in and explore what's new![/h3]

[h3]⬆️ Demo Update​​[/h3]
We've enhanced the demo with a host of new features! Players can now explore new levels, experience stunning effects, and immerse themselves in a brand-new biome. [b]The highlight of this update is the introduction of online multiplayer[/b], adding yet another way to connect and play with friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/b1cbee205f4adbd76fd5aae8cfecdcbf99a32af5.png[/img]

[h3]​​🌈 Responsive RGB Sea VFX​​[/h3]
We added [b]a new visual effect that reacts dynamically to one of the puzzle mechanics in the game[/b]. This responsive RGB sea effect adds a layer of interactivity and just looks really cool in our opinion 😄 Can you guess which puzzle mechanic it responds to?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/4f7193d607fd6134e9f71f82d8af00d674c64b6b.gif[/img]

[h3]🤖 Brand New Levels​​[/h3]
[b]The later chapters have additional puzzles that provide more challenges and opportunities for players to test their skills[/b]. We're currently working on further increasing the content and replayability, ensuring that Bytebond remains engaging and fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/2bafde614fa107d6f5cc4ab41d8404cf1a4b61da.png[/img]

[h3]💥 Finishing the Final Boss​​[/h3]
[b]We're in the final stages of developing the climactic battle with the virus.[/b] While we don't want to give away too much, we can assure you that this final boss fight will be an epic conclusion to your journey in Bytebond 😎

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Defenders! 🛡️[/h2]

[h3]We're excited to share some recent updates with you. Let's dive in and explore what's new![/h3]

[h3]❄️ Snow update[/h3]
In the latest update, snowy landscapes have been transformed with the addition of deformable snowdrifts. Now, we can roll around in the snow, leaving our marks on the pristine white canvas. The interactivity of other snowy elements has also been enhanced, making rolling in the snow even more fun 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/1257fff636c2c647cfc1ff2d5aa4f1eed12b27df.gif[/img]

[h3]🌈 New colourful theme[/h3]
A vibrant new theme is on the horizon, and we've been catching glimpses of it. Soon, we'll be exploring a colourful RGB land that'll look much different compared to the parts of the computer we already know. We're eagerly awaiting the next biome reveal to learn more about this dazzling new environment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/5393179bb3680d33dd4c5e073971b62a2da5efb9.gif[/img]

[h3]💻 Motherboard lobby[/h3]
At the heart of our world lies the Motherboard Lobby, the central hub where all antivirus forces' can take a moment to rest. This cozy hub world is our sanctuary, a place to relax, check our progress, and even change our appearance! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/685ac4de597a81264ad790af23b75168e816d74b.gif[/img]

[h3]💾 Save system[/h3]
Lastly, our progress is now safeguarded with a save system that records our achievements in real-time as we overcome obstacles and solve puzzles. Whether we want to restore our last state or start afresh, we have the flexibility to pick up right where we left off.

Until next time!
[b]Bleep & Bloop OUT! ⚡[/b]

notes.title: Looking for playtesters!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Defenders! 🛡️[/h2]

[h3][b]Exciting news! Our playtests start today, and we can't wait for you to dive in 🎉[/b][/h3]
This is an exclusive opportunity to dive behind the scenes and provide valuable feedback to help us shape the future of our game ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/90e618cc120e053b7ce28b36142e1dbc325f3fe5.gif[/img]

[h3][b]What can you expect?[/b][/h3]
[b]🤖 New In-Game Content[/b]
Be among the first to experience the latest updates, features, and improvements added to Bytebond! Test out new levels and mechanics, and let us know what works for you, and what needs a further polish! 

[b]🤖 The Scope[/b]
This build consists of two levels, which should take approximately an hour in total to finish.

[b]🤖 Playing Together In Co-op[/b]
Bytebond is meant to be played together! Thanks to Steam Remote Play, you can send an invite to your friend from the Main Menu of the game. Don't worry if you've never done that — we've prepared a detailed explanation in the game 😁

[b]🤖 Working Closely With Develolpers[/b]
Play Bytebond and report anything you find odd straight to the developers. From bugs to additional features, your feedback will be invaluable for the team behind the game.

[b]🤖 Limited Slots Available[/b]
Playtest slots are limited. Become a part of a small, trusted group, and have a large impact on the development of Bytebond.

[h2][b]How to Sign Up[/b] [/h2]
We're looking for people who want to play [b]AND [/b]leave their feedback! If that sounds like you:
1. Visit our [b]Steam page[/b] 👇🏼 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952690/Bytebond/
2. Click on the [b]"Request Access"[/b] button to join the playtest. 
3. Keep an eye on your email for further instructions and confirmation. 

[h2][b]How to Report[/b] [/h2]
You can report any issues through👉 [b][url=https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=ozmne4m6lUG53HO0uXS3dECI5g-k5ktKleRe49QKGShUNkQyU05RRDdENVhLS0UzRkEySjBLSlhZQyQlQCN0PWcu]THIS LINK[/url][/b] 👈 or join our [url=https://discord.gg/sMFWjmWvaU][b]Discord[/b][/url], where we’ve set up a feedback channel for that purpose. Just grab a [b]playtester role[/b] or tag our Community Manager to give you one 😉

We're counting on you!
[b]Bleep & Bloop OUT! ⚡[/b]

notes.title: New Biome - it's a bit SPOOKY! 🕸️
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Defenders! 🛡️[/h2]

[h3]It's Bleep and Bloop, and we're excited to show you a new place in our computer! 🤖🤖[/h3]

Some of you might have noticed a bit of it in our [b] gameplay trailer![/b] You can watch it here in case you missed it: 
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1952690/announcements/detail/4328607698668982756

The chase after the virus leads us into the depths of a dusty and forgotten [b]CD-ROM drive[/b]. Who knows what might be lurking in the shades of its cog wheels and mechanical parts?

The gloomy tone of dust and cobwebs fits perfectly the [b]spooky October vibes![/b] 🕸️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/6221471f29ec1b00be2a2f57af54218cba32d635.png[/img]

And it wouldn’t be a true CD-ROM without [b]lasers[/b], brought to life as a fresh gameplay mechanic. The energy-transferring skill will help you [b]guide the laser beam[/b] in order to [b]toggle switches[/b] and progress further.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/887b956a1306bc9d65b69ed5ead38917681cb36d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/498a220e87ec0b2f871dca051cacf84bc8876761.png[/img]

This chapter will also put the “bond” into “byte”, by introducing an [b]energy link feature[/b]. Once you connect yourselves with a beam of energy you have to [b]avoid obstacles[/b] in order to keep the energy flowing. Maybe this powerful flow of energy will be able to destroy some virus bots...?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/742bce911924ead8f6092ebfe760db18b3787645.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/ef12ee05ce299af2dc8c8d8351f1d96b746cf5b1.png[/img]

The vicious Virus will definitely try to stop you, but I’m sure you and the robots will manage to outsmart it! Maybe you’ll even make some friends along the way... 🙉

notes.title: From Snowmen to Firewalls!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Defenders! 🛡️[/h2]

[h3]It's Bleep and Bloop, and we've got a special report for you! 🤖🤖[/h3]
We've been busy this month, brewing up some exciting new updates, and we're thrilled to share them with you![b] Let's dive in and explore what's new [/b]in Bytebond world ✨

[h3]☃️ Winter Wonderland Awaits[/h3]
You may have seen a sneak peek of it before, but we made the new biome even [i]cooler[/i]! 😉
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1952690/view/6618688836650098409

What's a winter scene without some [b]snowmen[/b]? Ours resemble our adorable robots, and yes,[b] you can smash them 😂[/b] Oh, and those pesky snowdrifts? Feel free to barrel through them and watch them crumble!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/9a22e865bf040db75a9f598d6b1b2022c6dca7ad.png[/img]

[h3]🚨 BEAMS[/h3]
Say hello to our latest addition:[b] the laser beams[/b]! Not just a nifty tool for puzzle-solving, it adds a shock of excitement—and maybe a touch of danger—to your adventure. So steer those beams wisely and keep an eye out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/7288e3d2f304f666b3dc7bcbbb22418baffcc088.gif[/img]

[h3]📖 Storytime[/h3]
Dive deeper into another layer of our escapades as we tackle that [b]pesky virus[/b] causing[b] chaos in the computer. [/b]We added new levels and deepened our story. The plot thickens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/cf1bff72bb5fc29facad14bfa32e7abe253dd5df.png[/img]

[h3]🧱 Firewall [/h3]
There's nothing quite like the satisfaction of giving that virus what's coming to it! We've refreshed the visual effects for the end of a chapter, making the moment you activate the firewall even[b] more exciting. [/b]Get ready to enjoy that satisfying feeling as you [b]deliver a powerful blow to the virus[/b] and[b] secure the system.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/449399d6ea4587013be07a2f7d8c762b20be4d7d.png[/img]

[h3]🎮 Friendly Co-op[/h3]
We've added full Steam [b]friend invites support[/b], plus a [b]LAN mode[/b] for those local game nights. And to make sure you’re not lost in menus, we’ve spruced up the main menu to[b] simplify joining games.[/b] Less hassle, more play! 🎮

That's a wrap for this month's changes! We hope these updates will make you even more excited to jump into Bytebond. 🤖🤖

Until next time!
[b]Bleep & Bloop OUT! ⚡[/b]

notes.title: New Biome - isn't it COOL? ☃️
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Defenders! 🛡️[/h2]

[h3]It's Bleep and Bloop, and we're excited to show you a new place in our computer! 🤖🤖[/h3]

Some of you might have seen bits from our recently released[b] gameplay trailer![/b] You can watch it here in case you missed it: 
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1952690/announcements/detail/4328607698668982756

After completing the Training Program in Chapter 1, which is set within the USB Stick alongside the Antivirus, you will get to explore an entirely new environment — [b]the computer’s cooling system[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/6a7c1bf7dbef2ae2ee706dcc1c58f8cbe42eca9a.png[/img]

Picture an [b]icy[/b], [b]cold place[/b] with lots of [b]radiators [/b]and [b]pipes [/b]that move [b]cooling liquid[/b] around. Snow covers the ground, and you’ll [b]see your tracks as you move[/b]—and maybe a few [b]tiny snowmen too[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/f7fd61e1ff451a5ccbcc85f87ada19c9b43f38e8.png[/img]

But be careful—[b]the snowy ground is slippery![/b] Ice patches make it tricky to walk around, adding a [b]fun challenge[/b]. Sometimes, icicles hang from platforms, and huge ice blocks make up the background ❄️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/14d0ce1940e738256b40a3429a65116bcdf9ae87.png[/img]

Your mission? [b]Stop the evil Virus![/b] It’s trying to mess up the cooling system, and it’s up to you to keep things running smoothly. While you’re at it, you’ll also get to try out two new cool features: the [b]Cube [/b]and [b]Energy Impulse[/b], which bring fresh ways to play. But more on that in another update!

For now - [b]Bleep & Bloop OUT! ⚡[/b]

notes.title: New lights, new levels, same old us 🤖🤖
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Defenders! 🛡️[/h2]

[h3]It's Bleep and Bloop, and we've got a special report for you! 🤖🤖[/h3]
There were quite a lot of different things going on this month! Would you like to have a look and see [b]what changed?[/b] :>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/39294c36121bb2aaae62eea948071b276876255a.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]🤖 Online Co-op — Work in progress! 🤖[/b][/h3]
First off, we've been working on [b]improving the network co-op[/b]. While the online co-op was already in place, we focused on making it even better. It should be easier from now on to play together with your friends online. We [b]smoothed out the connection process[/b], so you can jump into the action without any hiccups.

[h3][b]🤖 Storyboard — Done! 🤖[/b][/h3]
We had a big meeting and planned out the entire story of Bytebond. We did our best to [b]plan the routes[/b] and [b]predict the events in each biome[/b]. We even think [b]we figured out where Bytebond leads us![/b] ⚠️ [b]Spoiler alert[/b] - it's going to be a fun ride! But don't worry, we won't spill the beans... [b]yet [/b]👀

[h3][b]🤖 New Models — Implemented! 🤖[/b][/h3]
New models appeared in one of the biomes! We think these are some kinds of [b]cubes, microphones, lights, and stuff.[/b] It's like a robot disco in there! 🪩 Can you tell where did we find them? :>
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/d3dd8789be642cf94fb0b20a1081149d01b75c41.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/5130a6eb8a8bca3b4ef291981a81a767582e98d6.png[/img]

[h3][b]🤖 New levels — Work in progress! 🤖[/b][/h3]
New places appeared in our PC! We'd love to explore them, but they seem different from what we know, and we're a bit too scared to go alone. [b]Would you like to explore them together? Let us know![/b]

Follow [url=https://linktr.ee/ansharpublishing][b]Anshar Publishing[/b][/url] to stay up-to-date! August is going to be very eventful! 😵‍💫
[b]Bleep & Bloop OUT![/b] ⚡
